items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: I heard Buddy. Player Buddy was just starting out. The first time I heard Armstrong... they had a fellow named Frazier playing the baritone. I know two or three guys. Rene was back there with him too.

ctx.x: But you never heard him play then?

I saw him and heard him play when I was a kid. I didn't know who he was, because I wasn't interested. All I cared during that time was to dance and follow the band. That's all I cared. You didn't know the names, man. No, I didn't know the names. I heard Buddy. Player Buddy was just starting out. The first time I heard Armstrong, the dedication of the Tonlefong Playground, they had a little band to come out and play. And they had a fellow named Frazier playing the baritone. I know two or three guys. Rene was back…
Do you think Rene was like a good reader and all that too? I don't think so. His band was just ad libbing when you heard him.
